summary: The figure shows a subnational map of Zimbabwe with districts and provinces color-coded by HIV incidence rates among adolescent girls and young women aged 15–24 years as of December 2021. The highest HIV incidence rates (up to 11 per 1000 uninfected population) are concentrated in the southern provinces of Matabeleland South and Bulawayo, with some districts in Midlands and Harare also showing elevated rates. Northern and eastern provinces generally show lower incidence rates. The map includes administrative boundaries at province and district levels and a color scale from 0 to 11 new infections per 1000 uninfected population.
